assets.title: Command-center masthead animation

provenance.author: STEX project owner
provenance.rights: Owned by St. Expedite Press; all rights reserved.
provenance.notes: Original 8.00 s render, 14.9 Mbit/s, no audio. The art occupies a 3.18:1 band (rows 220-822) between near-black bars (#09161C). Last-to-first SSIM 0.787 against a normal step of 0.986: needs the crossfade loop. Motion concentrates in the hair, drapery, and low clouds; face, arm, and sun are steadier. Parchment text over the stripe fails contrast except at x < 0.10 and x > 0.90.

assets.usage: Command-center masthead loop. Derivatives to be cropped to the art band.
assets.alt: Decorative; hidden from assistive technology. See P02 for a description.
